name: a2a (seed-classifier delegation via chat)
notes: New chat opens a conversation at once (routes/Chat.svelte, startConversation), on the Apollia agent; the first message is typed in its composer.

The skill of the seeded agent is agent:seed-classifier: an agent is a record of a package and takes a message, and the classify_text skill the chip used to name is gone with the manifest that declared it (the seed package now declares classify_text as a tool). The chip step names the current skill id and is expected to FAIL on the application as it is, on purpose: every stored agent is registered with supports_a2a false, no skill and no agent type (crates/apollia-tools/src/agent_definition.rs, manifest_of), the badge keeps the agents that support A2A and are workers (A2AWorkerBadge.svelte), and the desktop command list_a2a_skills reads the skills of the registry alone (commands/chat.rs), so the popover lists no worker and no chip. The step is left to say so rather than removed.

The delegation is best effort and asserts nothing about what the model does: the seed grants the Apollia agent no agent:seed-classifier access, and an agent reaches another one only through an access it was granted (crates/apollia-runtime/src/composition.rs). The turn is driven to its end and its last message captured.

steps.text: Bonjour, je vais te demander une classification.
Demande à l'agent seed-classifier de classer le texte "chaudiere gaz du site A" parmi les labels scope1, scope2 et scope3. Rends uniquement le label.
